name: GitHub CLI & Restricted Token Auth
description: Installs GitHub CLI (gh) if not present, forwards the host's DEVCONTAINER_GITHUB_TOKEN into GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN inside the container, and configures Git to authenticate over HTTPS using that token.

version.description: GitHub CLI (gh) version to install when gh is not already present (e.g. 'latest' or '2.67.0')

gitProtocol.description: When 'https', rewrites git@github.com: and ssh://git@github.com/ remotes to https://github.com/ in system Git config so git push/pull uses the restricted token instead of forwarded host SSH keys
